content_of_post_to_comment: I would feel a lot more sanguine about the fate of our democracy if people had turned against Trump because of corruptions and injuries to the rule of law rather than high fuel prices. It tells me that a lot of people, and maybe even a majority of voters, would be completely okay with Trumpism if it came with lower prices. And that’s a bit scary.
comment: The harder question may be whether voters see democratic norms as principles or as luxuries that matter only when daily life feels secure. That vulnerability exists beyond any single politician.
